privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.summaryBody: Fish Tracker is an offline-first fishing logbook. There are no user accounts and no cloud database for your catches. Your fishing data stays on this device unless you choose to export a backup or use an optional online feature.
privacy.storedBody: The app can store sessions, catches, lakes and spots, photos, optional profile and license details, settings, and assistant chat history. All of this lives locally in your browser.
privacy.storageBody: Fishing data is kept in this browser using IndexedDB and localStorage. The app itself may be hosted as a static website, but that host does not store your fishing logbook.
privacy.thirdPartiesIntro: Nothing is uploaded by default. Data is only sent when you use a feature that needs the network:
privacy.thirdPartyWeather: Weather: location coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for forecasts.
privacy.thirdPartyGeocode: Place lookup: search text or coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
privacy.thirdPartyMaps: Maps: opening a maps link sends coordinates to Google Maps in your browser.
privacy.thirdPartyAi: Optional AI: if you enable online AI, a summary of fishing stats (not photos) is sent to the provider you configured.
privacy.photosBody: Photos stay on this device in local storage. They are not uploaded to a server. They are only included if you export a backup file yourself.
privacy.pinBody: The optional PIN is a casual screen lock. It is stored as a hash, not as plain text. It does not encrypt your fishing data — someone with access to this device or browser tools can still read it.
privacy.backupsBody: Export creates a JSON file on your device that can include GPS history, catches, profile details, and photos. Keep backup files somewhere safe. Import replaces the data currently stored in this browser.
privacy.controlBody: You can wipe everything with a full reset in Settings or by clearing this site’s data in your browser. Fish Tracker does not use analytics or advertising SDKs.
